blocks.text: Have you and your friend ever been to a museum together, looked at the same painting, and had different reactions to it? If the painting you looked at was a seascape, you may have liked it because the dark colors and enormous waves reminded you of the wonderful memories you had in your hometown. In contrast, your friend might have had a negative reaction and said that the same things brought fear to his mind as he remembered sailing on a rough sea during a violent storm.
Our experience may influence how we interpret paintings.

readingSentences.english: Public parks provide a vital green sanctuary within noisy modern cities.
readingSentences.korean: 공공 공원은 소음이 심한 현대 도시 속에서 필수적인 녹색 안식처를 제공한다.

readingSentences.english: They offer city dwellers a place to walk, exercise, and reconnect with nature.
readingSentences.korean: 공원은 도시 거주자들에게 걷고, 운동하며, 자연과 다시 교감할 수 있는 장소를 마련해 준다.

readingSentences.english: Urban trees filter pollution and significantly reduce heat island effects.
readingSentences.korean: 도시의 나무들은 오염 물질을 걸러주고 열섬 현상을 크게 완화시켜 준다.

readingSentences.english: Investing in urban greenery enhances both public health and quality of life.
readingSentences.korean: 도시 녹지에 투자하는 것은 시민 건강과 삶의 질 모두를 향상시킨다.
